damage_bonus: Add flat_damage once to each completed damaging basic attack or skill. Never once per animation frame. Single-target only in v0.1.
health_bonus: Add max_hp to maximum HP. Preserve current HP on equip; clamp to new maximum on unequip. Never heal on equip.
loot_owner_policy: Highest eligible non-disconnected player damage contributor, ties stable by player identity; party handling deferred.
loot_looting: Ground loot items exist as server-owned world entities; no auto-add on kill.
recipe_behavior: One-use scroll. Use action attempts immediate crafting; on success scroll and ingredients consumed atomically and output inserted. On failure nothing changes. Single-click selection reveals ingredient checklist.
